connector.name: Sciple Platform
connector.registryDescription: Sciple platform MCP: services, dashboards, runbooks, tickets, environments, AWS cloud inventory.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package sciple-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the navaganeshr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SCIPLE_PLATFORM_URL
env.description: Sciple platform base URL (e.g. https://your.sciple.cloud). Optional — when omitted, the server uses the default platform recorded in the OAuth credential cache. Set this only when multiple platforms are cached.
